titleEn: Maximum Employees to Be Invited to a Meeting
title: 参加会议的最多员工数
summary: 每名员工只愿坐在其唯一喜欢的人旁边，圆桌最多能安排多少员工。
insight: 喜欢关系是每点出度一的函数图。拓扑剥离非环节点并维护到各节点的最长入链；长度大于二的环只能取最大一个，所有二环则可同时拼接并附上两端最长入链。
pitfalls: 二环可以累计而非只取最大
入链长度包含环端点自身

solutions.title: 函数图剥叶与环统计
solutions.idea: 拓扑阶段求链长，剩余节点组成纯环。
steps: 统计 indegree，队列加入度零节点，distance 初始一
遍历剩余环：二环贡献 distance[a]+distance[b] 并累计；其他环取最大长度；返回两者最大

code.java: class Solution { public int maximumInvitations(int[] favorite){int n=favorite.length;int[] indegree=new int[n],depth=new int[n];Arrays.fill(depth,1);for(int value:favorite)indegree[value]++;Queue<Integer> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(indegree[i]==0)queue.offer(i);while(!queue.isEmpty()){int node=queue.poll(),next=favorite[node];depth[next]=Math.max(depth[next],depth[node]+1);if(--indegree[next]==0)queue.offer(next);}int pairSum=0,longestCycle=0;boolean[] seen=new boolean[n];for(int start=0;start<n;start++)if(indegree[start]>0&&!seen[start]){int length=0,node=start;do{seen[node]=true;length++;node=favorite[node];}while(node!=start);if(length==2)pairSum+=depth[start]+depth[favorite[start]];else longestCycle=Math.max(longestCycle,length);}return Math.max(pairSum,longestCycle);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumInvitations(favorite:IntArray):Int{val n=favorite.size;val indegree=IntArray(n);val depth=IntArray(n){1};for(value in favorite)indegree[value]++;val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();for(i in 0 until n)if(indegree[i]==0)queue.add(i);while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val node=queue.removeFirst();val next=favorite[node];depth[next]=maxOf(depth[next],depth[node]+1);if(--indegree[next]==0)queue.add(next)};var pairSum=0;var longestCycle=0;val seen=BooleanArray(n);for(start in 0 until n)if(indegree[start]>0&&!seen[start]){var length=0;var node=start;do{seen[node]=true;length++;node=favorite[node]}while(node!=start);if(length==2)pairSum+=depth[start]+depth[favorite[start]]else longestCycle=maxOf(longestCycle,length)};return maxOf(pairSum,longestCycle)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int maximumInvitations(vector<int>& favorite){int n=favorite.size();vector<int> indegree(n),depth(n,1);for(int value:favorite)++indegree[value];queue<int> pending;for(int i=0;i<n;++i)if(!indegree[i])pending.push(i);while(!pending.empty()){int node=pending.front();pending.pop();int next=favorite[node];depth[next]=max(depth[next],depth[node]+1);if(!--indegree[next])pending.push(next);}int pairSum=0,longestCycle=0;vector<bool> seen(n);for(int start=0;start<n;++start)if(indegree[start]&&!seen[start]){int length=0,node=start;do{seen[node]=true;++length;node=favorite[node];}while(node!=start);if(length==2)pairSum+=depth[start]+depth[favorite[start]];else longestCycle=max(longestCycle,length);}return max(pairSum,longestCycle);} };
